description: This file contains functions for generating and preparing VBMeta images for Android's Cuttlefish virtual machine environment, including handling of boot configurations and AP boot flow logic.

methods.name: PrepareVBMetaImage
methods.description: Prepares a VBMeta image at the specified path, optionally including boot configuration, by creating a chained partition with a specific key.

methods.name: GeneratePersistentVbmeta
methods.description: Generates a persistent VBMeta image based on the provided Cuttlefish configuration instance, handling different boot flows and validation.
